# Libraries Kamira loads from here

Copied as-is from npm, so the site doesn't depend on another website being up.

| File | Package | License | Loaded when |
|---|---|---|---|
| supabase.js | @supabase/supabase-js 2.117.3 (dist/umd) | MIT | the cloud is set up (sign-in, saving, feed) |
| tf.min.js | @tensorflow/tfjs 4.22.0 | Apache-2.0 | someone makes a page public |
| nsfwjs.min.js | nsfwjs 4.4.0 (dist/browser) | MIT | someone makes a page public |
| nsfw-model/ | nsfwjs 4.4.0 MobileNetV2 model, unpacked from dist/models/mobilenet_v2 into plain files | MIT | someone makes a page public |
